name: Floor - The Council
text: I have written to the council. I have also written to you, but the council will act.

name: Floor - The Other One
text: I am not angry. I am the other one. The one who keeps receipts.

name: Floor - The Form
text: One star, and only because the form would not let me leave it blank.

name: Floor - The Tent
text: I have stayed in a tent. I am not going to say more than that, but I have stayed in a tent.

name: Floor - No Room
text: {hours} hours without a room. I stood in your lobby like furniture, and furniture at least gets sat on.

name: Floor - By Mistake
text: {hours} hours and no room. Every other hotel has given me a room, and one of them did it by mistake.

name: Floor - In Writing
text: No room for {hours} hours. I want to be clear that I had a booking, and that I had it in writing.

name: Floor - A Building
text: {hours} hours in your lobby. A hotel with no room in it is a building, and I could have stood in a building at home.

name: Floor - Nowhere To Sit
text: {hours} hours. I waited {hours} hours to sit down. I am told that is not a record.

name: Floor - Standing Is Free
text: {hours} hours on my feet. I did not come here to stand. Standing is available everywhere and it is free.

name: Floor - I Looked Properly
text: Nowhere to sit for {hours} hours. I looked. I looked properly, and then I looked again.

name: Floor - My Legs Wrote Theirs
text: {hours} hours upright. My legs have written their own review and it is shorter and angrier than this one.

name: Floor - Nothing To Do
text: {hours} hours and nothing happened. Nothing at all. I checked twice.

name: Floor - My Entire Week
text: {hours} hours with nothing to do. I have now planned my entire week. I did not want to.

name: Floor - Conversations I Regret
text: Nothing to do for {hours} hours. I have started conversations I regret and finished none of them.

name: Floor - A Circus
text: {hours} hours of nothing. I understand that a hotel is not a circus. I would have taken a circus.

name: Floor - Nothing To Eat
text: {hours} hours, no food, and I would like that painted on the front of the building.

name: Floor - On A Train
text: {hours} hours without a meal. I have eaten better on a train, and I say that having eaten on a train.

name: Floor - In Writing
text: No food for {hours} hours. I am prepared to describe my hunger in writing to anyone who asks.

name: Floor - Very Seriously
text: {hours} hours and nothing to eat. I would like this taken seriously. I am taking it very seriously.

name: Poor - Let Them Wonder
text: I expected more. I will not be saying what. Let them wonder.

name: Poor - The Effort
text: Two stars. The second one is for effort, and I am being generous about the effort.

name: Poor - For Some Time
text: Disappointing throughout, in a way I intend to think about for some time.

name: Poor - Do Not Ask
text: I have been in worse. I would rather not be asked when, or where, or with whom.

name: Poor - No Sleep
text: I did not sleep. {hours} hours of not sleeping, in a hotel, which is the one thing a hotel is for.

name: Poor - Paid To Lie Down
text: {hours} hours awake. I have paid to lie down and I did not lie down.

name: Poor - Cheaper At Home
text: No rest for {hours} hours. I could have stayed awake at home for considerably less.

name: Poor - I Asked Nicely
text: {hours} hours without so much as a bed, and I would like it noted that I asked nicely throughout.

name: Poor - Standing
text: I would like it noted that I spent {hours} hours upright. Standing. In a hotel.

name: Poor - A Small Peace
text: {hours} hours with nowhere to sit. I have made my peace with it, and my peace is very small.

name: Poor - Not A Throne
text: Nowhere to sit, {hours} hours. I am not asking for a throne. I am asking a long way downward from a throne.

name: Poor - To A Person
text: {hours} hours standing. I did not know that was a thing a hotel could do to a person.

name: Poor - Nothing To Do
text: Nothing to do for {hours} hours. I have been through my own pockets twice and found nothing.

name: Poor - Counting
text: {hours} hours of nothing. I have counted things I did not previously wish to count.

name: Poor - My Life
text: Nothing whatever to do, for {hours} hours. I have thought about my life. It went badly.

name: Poor - Looking Forward
text: {hours} hours unoccupied. I have begun to look forward to leaving, and I have written that down.

name: Poor - Empty Stomach
text: {hours} hours without food. I am writing this on an empty stomach and I think it shows.

name: Poor - Not A Principle
text: {hours} hours and no meal. I have gone hungry for a principle before. This was not that.

name: Poor - In Charge Of Food
text: No food, {hours} hours. I would like to speak to whoever is in charge of food. I suspect nobody is.

name: Poor - Emergency Biscuits
text: {hours} hours unfed. I did bring emergency biscuits. They are gone, and so is my goodwill.

name: Fair - It Was A Hotel
text: It was a hotel. It was, I suppose, a hotel.

name: Fair - The Middle
text: Three stars. That is the middle, and the middle is where I have put it.

name: Fair - The Word Fine
text: Fine. Perfectly fine. I have written the word fine four times now and deleted three of them.

name: Fair - The Postage
text: No complaints worth the postage, and none of the other kind either.

name: Fair - The Ceiling
text: Slept badly. {hours} hours of ceiling. I know that ceiling now. We are acquainted.

name: Fair - If Pressed
text: {hours} hours awake, then sleep. I would call that a night's rest if pressed, and I am being pressed.

name: Fair - Eventually
text: Rest came eventually, {hours} hours after I asked for it. Eventually is a word doing a great deal of work there.

name: Fair - Adequate
text: {hours} hours of lying there. Adequate. I have had adequate before and I recognised it at once.

name: Fair - Coat Rack
text: Pleasant enough. Nowhere to sit for {hours} hours. I stood in the lobby like a coat rack.

name: Fair - Exercise
text: Decent, apart from {hours} hours on my feet, which I have decided to describe as exercise.

name: Fair - Agreeable
text: {hours} hours without a seat. Otherwise agreeable. I am an agreeable man with a grievance.

name: Fair - A Shame
text: Nowhere to sit for {hours} hours. I would not call it a scandal. I would call it a shame.

name: Fair - Hotels With Rooms
text: It was a hotel. It had rooms. I have stayed in hotels with rooms before.

name: Fair - Fairer Than It Deserves
text: Nothing much to do, and nothing much wrong. I have written a fairer review than this deserves.

name: Fair - Quiet
text: Quiet. Very quiet. The kind of quiet a man notices, and then mentions, and then mentions again.

name: Fair - Simply There
text: I was not entertained. I was not un-entertained. I was simply there, at length.

name: Fair - The Sandwich
text: I did not travel all this way to spend {hours} hours queueing for a sandwich. I say that as a patient man.

name: Fair - Earlier
text: {hours} hours before I ate. The food arrived. So did I, considerably earlier.

name: Fair - Not The Same
text: Waited {hours} hours to be fed. It was worth waiting for, which is not the same as worth {hours} hours.

name: Fair - The Second Part
text: {hours} hours hungry, then not hungry. A hotel should aim for the second part rather sooner.

name: Good - My Wife Disagrees
text: Nearly perfect. My wife disagrees, but she disagrees professionally.

name: Good - Policy
text: Very good. I am withholding the fifth star as a matter of policy, not as a matter of fact.

name: Good - People I Like
text: Would recommend, quietly, to people I like.

name: Good - The Fifth Star
text: Four stars. The fifth is out there somewhere and I have never given it to anybody.

name: Good - The Traffic
text: Good hotel. I was awake for {hours} hours of it, which I have decided to blame on the traffic.

name: Good - Eventually
text: Slept well, eventually. {hours} hours of eventually. A small price, grudgingly paid.

name: Good - Rounded Up
text: {hours} hours awake and then a proper night. I have rounded that up in your favour.

name: Good - Light Sleeper
text: Comfortable throughout, except for {hours} hours of it, and I am admittedly a light sleeper.

name: Good - Not A Young Man
text: Very nearly perfect. {hours} hours without a chair. I am not a young man and I made this known.

name: Good - For Completeness
text: Lovely stay. {hours} hours on my feet, which I mention only for completeness.

name: Good - Big About It
text: {hours} hours standing about, in an otherwise excellent hotel. I have decided to be big about it.

name: Good - Several People
text: Good throughout. I did stand for {hours} hours, and I did tell several people at the time.

name: Good - United In Nothing
text: Lovely place. Nothing whatever to do in it. Others were also doing nothing, so at least we were united.

name: Good - Never Stopped Saying It
text: Excellent hotel, nothing to do in it. I have never minded that, and I have never stopped saying it.

name: Good - In Fact Needed
text: Very good. I brought my own amusement and it was not needed. It was, in fact, needed.

name: Good - Idle But Splendid
text: Splendid. Idle, but splendid. I have been idle in considerably worse places.

name: Good - Would Eat First
text: Would return. Would eat first.

name: Good - A Precaution
text: Very good indeed. I would advise arriving fed, as a precaution rather than as a complaint.

name: Good - Not Explored
text: Excellent hotel. I did not eat here, and I have chosen not to explore why.

name: Good - A Full Stomach
text: Four stars, and I would have made it five on a full stomach.

name: Top - Hard To Please
text: Nothing to report. I am told I am hard to please. I am not hard to please.

name: Top - At Length
text: Five stars. I have never given five stars. I have now, and I intend to say so at length.

name: Top - Looking For A Fault
text: Faultless. I looked for a fault. I looked in the way a man looks who badly wants to find one.

name: Top - No Notes
text: No notes. I have notes about having no notes, but no notes.

name: Top - Woke Once
text: Slept like a stone. Woke once. Went back to sleep. That is the entire report.

name: Top - A Triumph
text: Woke early, went back to sleep, woke again. I am counting that as a triumph.

name: Top - Forgiven
text: Slept well enough to forgive the bit where I did not.

name: Top - Give Or Take
text: A fine night, give or take a stretch of ceiling. I am giving and not taking.

name: Top - I Like Standing
text: Everything was fine. I stood for a while, but I like standing. My wife says I do not.

name: Top - Stood About
text: I did stand about for a bit. I have decided to enjoy having stood about.

name: Top - I Noticed
text: Nowhere to sit for a spell, which I mention only so that you know I noticed.

name: Top - A Wait For A Chair
text: Excellent. There was a wait for a chair. There is always a wait for a chair.

name: Top - I Brought A Book
text: Faultless. There was nothing to do, but I had brought a book, so that one is on me.

name: Top - Ideal
text: Very little to do, and I found that I did not want to do very much. Ideal.

name: Top - Quiet As A Sunday
text: Quiet as a Sunday. I have decided that was the point, and I am sticking to it.

name: Top - On My Account
text: Nothing much going on, which suited me exactly. Do not change it on my account.

name: Top - Ignore The Man
text: No notes. Ignore the man complaining about the food, he never stopped eating it.

name: Top - Worth The Wait
text: Fed, and fed well. I would not have waited for worse.

name: Top - Not A Man Who Says That
text: The food was worth the small delay, and I am not a man who says that.

name: Top - My Wife Is Not Wrong
text: I ate late and happily. My wife says I always eat late. My wife is not wrong.
